title: ATM Fee and Surcharge Reimbursement Schedule — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
**Pocketwire Visa Debit Card, cash access tariff.** All amounts are in USD.

### Table 1 — Pocketwire cash fees

| Card tier | Domestic out-of-network ATM fee | Free domestic out-of-network withdrawals per calendar month | International ATM fee | Out-of-network balance inquiry fee | Over-the-counter cash withdrawal fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 2.50 | 0 | 3.00 | 0.50 | 3.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 2.50 | 1 | 3.00 | 0.50 | 3.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 2.00 | 2 | 3.00 | 0.50 | 3.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 1.50 | 4 | 2.00 | 0.00 | 3.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 0.00 | 6 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 0.00 | 10 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

### Table 2 — ATM-owner surcharge reimbursement

| Card tier | Monthly reimbursement cap | Per-withdrawal reimbursement cap | Direct deposit requirement applies | Previous-month direct deposit total required | Refund window (calendar days after the withdrawal) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes | 300.00 | 60 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes | 300.00 | 60 |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 5.00 | 3.50 | yes | 300.00 | 60 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 10.00 | 3.50 | no | 300.00 | 60 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 20.00 | 5.00 | no | 300.00 | 90 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 50.00 | 10.00 | no | 300.00 | 90 |

**Tariff notes**

- The domestic out-of-network ATM fee is the Pocketwire fee on a domestic out-of-network withdrawal once the free monthly withdrawals are used up. The international ATM fee is the Pocketwire fee on an ATM withdrawal outside the United States.
- The monthly cap is the most in ATM-owner surcharges reimbursed in one calendar month. The per-withdrawal cap is the most reimbursed on a single withdrawal.
- Where the direct deposit requirement applies, the previous-month figure is the total of direct deposits into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account in the previous calendar month that surcharge reimbursement requires. On tiers marked "no" the figure is listed but not required.
- The refund window is the number of calendar days after the ATM withdrawal within which surcharge reimbursement can be requested.
- On Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit and Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit both reimbursement caps are 0.00, so no surcharge amount is reimbursed on those tiers.
